data.narrative:
Modern Intelligence is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by John Dulin, Joe Cieslik, and Tristan Tager, having raised $5.12M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (UFORCE, Singularity, NODA AI), supplemented by a broader set of 8 private and 2 public comps in the defense technology space.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology uses the $5.12M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series transitions, yielding an implied value of $12.8M. Peer-median analysis across the 3-company comp set produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $1.0B (UFORCE, Seed). The wide dispersion reflects material stage and funding-environment differences within the peer cohort.

The two methods produce substantially divergent signals. Triangulation across both approaches supports a valuation range of $11M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $206M. The extreme width of this range reflects genuine uncertainty: early-stage Defense & Security valuations exhibit high sensitivity to perceived technical differentiation, customer traction, and defense spending cycles. Reconciliation would require additional data on Modern Intelligence's revenue run-rate, customer pipeline, and technology validation relative to the peer set.
